race.comment: Open contest. MELTDOWN (10) has to be one of the main chances after missing narrowly at the Gold Coast. Has good tactical speed and is sure to give backers a sight. ROGUERY (5) is worth another chance after being checked near the 250m last start, with his prior BM78 effort better than it looks in this grade. Gets help at the weights again with Pozman sticking claiming 2kg. Watch for him bursting through. MAZIS (2) has the proven track-and-trip profile and was only a long neck off the winner here last start after being forced wide. Sutherland replaces Thompson with a 2kg claim. Doesn't need to improve much to lad a winning blow. MAKE A CALL (1) drops back from better and is capable of a stronger showing. Newman's claim helps.
